dataset: Natural Earth land v5.1.2 at 1:10 million scale
processing: Lakes excluded from land rendering and inspection. Coordinates rounded to 4 decimal degrees; properties omitted; geometry gzip/base64 embedded. No handmade island polygons added.
rendering: Default continuous production-potential surface for three cultivated-olive profiles and rainfed/irrigated scenarios. Climate and native winter temperatures, station-calibrated annual freeze hazard, and Cyprus local siting guidance determine scores; study coverage never enters the score. Version8 thermal constraints cannot be compensated by favorable winters or irrigation. In the irrigated view, muted diagonal stripes flag scores>=40 with annual rainfall<200mm; this is resource-dependence context, not observed groundwater/salinity data, and leaves numeric scores unchanged. Valid-neighbor interpolation and detailed land/lake clipping are shared by all views. Regional freeze data are not orchard-scale thermometer measurements.
